records.task: Locate both poles and the medial hilar recess in 3D, then relate them to the saved s1233 long-axis scan.

scoreEvidence.fidelity: The three protected CT sections agree within 1.21 mm p95 and 2.36 mm maximum. The saved refined chord is 103.3 mm against 104.3 mm from the CT outline.
scoreEvidence.form: The matched clay and reverse views show rounded poles, smooth broad areas and a preserved medial hilar recess. Some relief remains near the lower outer surface, so the finish needs a lead judgment against the CT reference.
scoreEvidence.readability: In reverse oblique, both poles and the recessed medial contour are recognizable. The live B-mode and tissue overlay show the same recess below the source-aligned calipers.
scoreEvidence.economy: 4,800 triangles and 86,432 bytes. The projected silhouette departs by 0.71 px at 3 px/mm in 24 views against the pre-decimation surface.

records.note: Provisional candidate. s1233 is a separate subject. The bright tissue is simulated and the source label represents an exterior. An independent lead review owns the final scores and disposition.
